text:
when God created love he didn't help much

when God created dogs he didn't help dogs

when God created plants he wasn't very original

when God created hate we had something useful


when God created me, well, he created me


when God created the monkey he was asleep

when he created the giraffe he was drunk

when he created drugs he was high

and when he created suicide he was depressed


when he created you sleeping in bed

he knew what he was doing

he was drunk and high

and created the mountains and the sea and fire at the same time


he made some mistakes

but when he created you sleeping in bed

he spilled himself over his Blessed Universe

translation.title: When God Created Love He Didn't Help Much...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the comic irreverence toward creation and the sudden praise of the beloved asleep.
